parserUnit: One date / three rows per call; full-year grouping is an offline Node audit, not a Worker CPU result
method: CNY per USD = EURCNY / EURUSD; CNY per HKD = EURCNY / EURHKD
limitations: Reference dates do not represent every calendar day. Prior reference dates require a verified TARGET calendar decision, not an arbitrary stale-rate fallback. Reference rates are not exact exchange close or actual bank execution rates. Derived rates are modifications of ECB data.
